prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1173; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, but I can answer your questions.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through an intersection in League City, Texas, turning left onto a side road. I had a green light, or at least I thought I did.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. It came from the opposite direction, and I was watching for pedestrians on the crosswalk. The first thing I noticed was the impact on the driver's side of my car.

Q: How fast were you going when you started the turn?

A: I was going slowly, maybe fifteen miles an hour. I had almost stopped because of the oncoming traffic.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My neck and lower back hurt right away, and by the next morning the pain had gotten worse. I went to a clinic and they diagnosed a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: A few days so far. My job involves lifting, so my doctor recommended I stay off it for now.

Q: Did you receive any treatment at the scene?

A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They checked me over, gave me muscle relaxers, and sent me home with instructions to follow up with my primary care doctor.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble sleeping and turning my head when I check traffic. I'd like to be made whole for the medical bills and the time I've lost.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
